name: Monument
one_liner: Online alcohol treatment platform with therapy, medication (naltrexone/acamprosate), and community support starting at $25/session with insurance.
short_description: Monument is an online platform for alcohol treatment offering therapy, FDA-approved medications, physician consultations, and community support groups.
long_description: Monument is an online alcohol treatment platform that helps people change their relationship with alcohol through a combination of therapy, medication-assisted treatment (MAT), and community support. The platform offers virtual appointments with licensed physicians and therapists specializing in alcohol use disorder, along with optional prescriptions for FDA-approved medications including naltrexone (including Vivitrol) and acamprosate. With insurance, therapy sessions cost $25 each. Monument supports the Sinclair Method using naltrexone. In May 2025, Monument expanded to offer full primary and urgent care services alongside their alcohol treatment program. The platform includes anonymous 24/7 community forums and free therapist-moderated support groups. Monument raised $10.3M in funding and is available in 18 states including CA, NY, TX, FL, and PA.
best_for: Individuals seeking evidence-based alcohol treatment online
People interested in medication-assisted treatment for AUD
Those wanting the Sinclair Method with naltrexone
Patients preferring virtual therapy for alcohol issues
not_for: Severe alcohol use disorder requiring inpatient/detox
Patients with physical dependence needing medical detox
Those needing support for multiple addictions

pricing.notes: Insurance accepted includes Aetna, Cigna, Blue Cross/Blue Shield in select states. No hidden fees. Free therapist-moderated support groups and 24/7 community forum included. Expanded to primary/urgent care in May 2025.

compliance.notes: HIPAA-compliant telehealth platform for alcohol treatment.

faqs.a: Monument costs $25 per session for therapy and medical appointments with insurance. Major insurers like Aetna, Cigna, and Blue Cross/Blue Shield are accepted in select states.
Monument physicians can prescribe FDA-approved medications including naltrexone (daily oral or monthly Vivitrol injection), acamprosate, and disulfiram for alcohol use disorder.

faqs.q: Does Monument support the Sinclair Method?
faqs.a: Yes, Monument explicitly supports the Sinclair Method, which involves taking naltrexone before drinking to reduce the rewarding effects of alcohol over time.
Monument is available in 18 states: AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, IA, KY, NJ, NY, OH, OR, PA, SC, TX, VA, and WA.

company_info.notes: Monument expanded beyond alcohol treatment to offer full primary and urgent care in May 2025.
